_comment: Replace Field Contents measured on FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 (macOS, 2026-10-19): each step was pasted into a script, FileMaker's displayed line read, and the step copied back (xml). Ids name the With mode, Restore (RT/RF) and SerialNumbers PerformAutoEnter (PT/PF).

FileMaker draws `Skip auto-enter options`, bare and last, exactly when Restore is True and PerformAutoEnter is False, in every With mode. Restore True with PerformAutoEnter True draws the same line as Restore False, so that pair is lossy on FileMaker's line by design.
